# 2 Baruch Chapter 27 — The EMET Bible (Literal)
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** Syriac MS (Codex Ambrosianus 7a1) | **Section:** Second Fast and Dialogue

---

**27:1** And-he-answered and-said to-me: That-time-will-be-divided into-twelve parts, and-each-one-of-them is-reserved for-that-which-is-appointed-for-it.

**27:2** In-the-first-part: the-beginnings of-commotions.

**27:3** In-the-second-part: the-slayings of-the-great-ones.

**27:4** In-the-third-part: the-fall of-many-into-death.

**27:5** In-the-fourth-part: the-drawing-of-the-sword.

**27:6** In-the-fifth-part: famine and-[the] withholding-of-rain.

**27:7** In-the-sixth-part: earthquakes and-terrors.

**27:8** In-the-seventh-part: the-demons and-evil-spirits.

**27:9** In-the-eighth-part: the-falling-of-fire and-[the] descent-of-Sheol.

**27:10** In-the-ninth-part: the-sword and-panic.

**27:11** In-the-tenth-part: transgression and-unchastity.

**27:12** In-the-eleventh-part: lawlessness and-lust.

**27:13** In-the-twelfth-part: confusion-of-the-mingling-of-all-the-previous-[parts]-with-the-others.

**27:14** These-parts-of-that-time are-reserved, and-they-will-be-handed-over to-his-appointed[-time], and-he-will-display them according-to-the-order of-their-times.

**27:15** And-I-said: That-time — is-it-long or-is-it-short?

---

*EMET notes: Translated from the Syriac Codex Ambrosianus. The twelve woes follow a strict list-format. Verse 15 is Baruch's immediate follow-up question within the revelation itself. The twelfth period (v.13) is described as a "confusion" combining all previous tribulations — an intensification to the maximum.*
